title: Make More Money From Customers You Already Have (The 4 Rs)
style: Read this like an energetic, honest small-business coach in a quick social video. Punchy on the hook, then clear.

segments.title: The easiest money is customers you already have
segments.say: The easiest money in your business isn't new customers. It's the ones you already have. It's called the four Rs, from Alex Hormozi, and the fourth R is where most of the money hides.

segments.title: One prompt, all 4 Rs
segments.say: Retain: check in three days after the sale. Review: ask for a review the same day. Refer: ask who else could use it. And resell: offer the next thing they'll need. Paste this prompt and AI writes all four messages for you in seconds.

chat.user: I sell [furniture]. A customer just bought [a sofa]. Write 4 short texts: a 3-day check-in, a review request, a referral ask, and an offer for [a matching rug].
chat.ai:
1) Hi Sam! How's the new sofa settling in?
2) Would you leave us a quick review? It helps a lot.
3) Know anyone else shopping for furniture?
4) Our matching rugs are 15% off this week.

segments.title: Help us hit 100 subscribers
bullets: Results vary. It still takes real work
segments.say: Results vary, and you still have to send the messages. We're a small channel trying to reach a hundred subscribers by December thirty first. If this helped, subscribing really helps.
